Hi all — quick technical note to prep the call: the CSV Jonas sent captures the baseline run (no prefix caching); in the readout I’ll show two comparison curves — baseline and with prefix/KV cache enabled — so you can see p95/p99 improvements. For the SOC2/security ask: we capture request/response metadata (no raw user data) and store audit logs for 90 days on the hosted trial; we can discuss retention options in Private deployments.

To make the session productive, could the infra team forward one example request trace (sanitized) and any firewall/egress constraints that might affect TLS handshake latency? That will help me call out what in your environment vs. model serving is contributing to tail latency.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Dev
